title: PLAYER 2 SEES THE MENDER BEAMS
why: The mender elite draws a green beam to each machine it is mending, the tell that says kill it first. Only the AI tick sets the beam (affixMend), and a linked window runs no AI (updateEnts returns at netEntsEase), so player 2 window never drew a single beam: the mender just stood there while the machines around it healed. Proven in one window staged as player 2: a mender with a half-hurt machine 60 away draws 0 beams. Now player 2 window works out the same targets with the host rule (same filter, same reach, up to 4, heals nothing) and draws the beams on the host rhythm, 0.4 s in every 0.5 s. No new data on the wire; the host is unchanged.
now: In co-op, player 2 now sees the green mender beams too, so he knows which machine to kill first.
